scope.purpose: Give a durable message about the page, a section or a task, in the flow of the page.
useCases: A failed save at the top of a form.
An expiring plan or a maintenance notice.
A success after a long import, with a follow-up action.
exclusions: Page-wide banners fixed at the top: a composition.
alternatives: Dialog for a message that needs an answer.

decisionsTaken: Colors from color.status.{intent}.* (surface, content, border, icon), like Badge subtle; intents neutral, info, success, warning, danger (no accent: an alert is a status).
Edge role named edgeColor because color.status.*.border is decorative (the Badge precedent) and the generic border check would require 3:1.
Intrinsic Phosphor glyphs per intent (info, check-circle, warning, warning-circle), replaceable through the icon slot.
Title typography.label.md, content typography.body.sm, padding space.content.md, radius.container.
dismissible shows a small ghost neutral IconButton named dismissLabel and emits dismiss; the application removes the alert.
live false by default (an alert present at load is not announced); live true announces assertively for danger and warning, politely otherwise.
Actions: one ButtonGroup of sm buttons under the content.

Accent buttons follow the alert intent by pointing the accent action tokens at the intent family in the subtree (no Button change); links take tone inherit through the context ggb:link-tone (2026-11-03).
nextAction: Delivery with wave 3: pull request of wave/3 to main (user merge); publication needs explicit authorization.
implementationNotes: Imports IconButton from ../icon-button (declared dependency; build:svelte now checks every import against the status dependencies).
Title and content are div elements, not p: an application's unlayered element styles (paragraph margins and colors) would otherwise win over the component's cascade layer.
The edge is an inset box-shadow, like the other components' borders, so that it never changes the outer size.
